department: Faculty of Science — Department of Chemistry

deadline.value: Main Round and Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPFS) deadline for 2027-28 entry is December 1, 2026 (1st Clearing Round: April 30, 2027; 2nd Clearing Round: August 31, 2027).

also.quote: In view of the limited admission quota, applicants are strongly encouraged to apply in the Main Round. Applications will be considered in the clearing rounds only if there are vacancies after the Main Round.

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for chemistry (ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Chemistry strongly encourages prospective applicants to communicate with one or more potential supervisors before applying.
supervisor.quote: Before application, you are strongly encouraged to explore the research interests of our Research Supervisors and to communicate with one or more potential supervisors, who will be able to discuss further details about their research programs and their projected number of RPg intakes in the upcoming academic year.

funding.value: Full-time PhD students with 2:1 honours (or equivalent) or above are normally eligible for Postgraduate Scholarships (HK$19,135/month; HK$19,655/month after confirmation, wef 1/9/2026), subject to funding availability, while HKU-PS/HKPF awardees receive HK$28,700/month plus tuition waiver and cash awards.
funding.quote: For non HKU-PS / non-HKPF Research Postgraduate (RPg) students | Postgraduate Scholarship (PGS) | Funding value: HK$19,135/month or HK$19,655/month# (wef 1/9/2026)

also.quote: other full-time PhD and MPhil students who hold a first degree with second-class honours first division (or equivalent) or above are normally considered eligible to receive a Postgraduate Scholarship (PGS) during the normative study period, subject to availability of funding.

entry_route.value: Admits First Class Honours bachelor's holders to the 4-year PhD, and research MPhil holders to the 3-year PhD (2A honours bachelor's holders enter via MPhil or 4-year PhD transfer).
entry_route.quote: A B. Sc. degree with IIA honours or above from this University or an equivalent qualification from a comparable institution. | An M. Phil. (Research) degree from this University or an equivalent qualification from a comparable institution. | A B. Sc. degree with 1st Honours from this University or an equivalent qualification from a comparable institution.

notes: Department webpage (chemistry.hku.hk/study/postgraduate_students/2/) still mentions an outdated HK$600 application fee; central Graduate School FAQ states HK$780.
